card.name: Odd characters at the start of notes
card.fires_on: Garbled or special symbol bytes (bullets, footnote marks, odd spaces) that stand in for a bullet or footnote marker after a table or list item. Also the last digit of a ZIP code before a phone line.

modes.label: Broken bullet or footnote symbol
modes.description: A garbled symbol appears right after a table footnote or list line, before the next sentence or item.

modes.label: Last digit of a ZIP code
modes.description: The final digit of a ZIP+4 code in a mailing address, just before a toll-free phone line.

modes.label: Odd space before a number
modes.description: A special space character sits before a number or table label.

card.plain: It fires on garbled bullet marks and stray symbols that separate notes, list items or address lines in drug labels.
